title: Rewinding the Yard Tape
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean Turing machine, let $A$ be a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $m$ be a natural number, and fix a Boolean loop setting. Choose an input-head position for $x$, work-tape contents and head positions for the work tapes of $S$ and $A$, and a Boolean word $w$ with $|w| \le m$. Starting the host machine in its second rewind phase, with the yard tape containing $m$ consecutive marks and its head at position $|w|-1$, and with empty output, running it on the choice word $w$ leaves it in the same phase with the yard-tape head at $-1$; the yard tape contents and all work-tape contents and head positions are unchanged, while the input head has moved left by $|w|$ positions, clamped at the input boundaries, and the output remains empty.
